purpose: Forecast direction only; no financial replay or trading authority

bootstrap.simultaneous_family: all candidates, targets, coverages and controls together

flat_policy: flat is a separate observed outcome; binary up/down predictions count as incorrect on flat; nonflat accuracy is secondary
sampling_policy: same time-based train sample for both feature sets and both targets; exclude target-specific flats only at fitting
gap_policy: no interpolation, no label across a source-day boundary, no missing calendar day in the registered 60-day batch
feature_policy: six price features plus seven frozen book features; separate train-only scaler on every origin and target
data_registration: dates and all bank/source hashes must be frozen before any multiday fitting; this protocol is not a sealed prospective interval
